title: Computerized Nikah Registration Application
description: Application for computerized marriage (Nikah) registration. Bride and groom details are written in both the English and the Urdu parts of the form.
notes: Each detail is written twice: in the English block and again in the Urdu block, as the form requires.
leaveBlank: Date of entry and date of issuance (filled by the registrar)
The whole "for office use" box at the bottom
